name: federal-recompete-radar
title: Federal Recompete Radar: Expiring Federal Government Contracts
description: Find US federal contracts expiring soon (upcoming recompetes) in USAspending.gov data. Filter by NAICS, PSC, agency, state, set-aside and value. Returns incumbent and UEI, agency, office, value, current and potential end dates and award link. $10 per 1,000 contracts.
